title: Path with Maximum Gold
summary: In a grid representing a gold mine, each cell contains a gold amount or zero.
statement: In a grid representing a gold mine, each cell contains a gold amount or zero. Collect the most gold by moving to adjacent cells, starting and ending at any cell with gold, without revisiting cells or cells with no gold.
constraints: Start at any positive cell and move orthogonally.
Collect a cell’s gold once; zero cells cannot be entered and no cell may be revisited.
Return the maximum gold collectable by one path.
hints: Try every positive cell as a starting point.
During DFS, temporarily mark the current cell zero, explore four positive unvisited neighbors, then restore it.
Return current gold plus the best continuation.
Temporary marking enforces simple paths, restoration makes branches independent, and exhaustive starts cover every possible path.
editorial: Temporary marking enforces simple paths, restoration makes branches independent, and exhaustive starts cover every possible path.

tests.explanation: The best connected path collects twenty-eight.
